pages.text: $(bold)Void Touch$() (built into void metal tools, $(bold)no levels$())$(br2)Melee or ranged hits with the tool inflict $(bold)Void Wane$() (goety_ladder:void_wane) for $(bold)3 seconds$(); if the target already has it, the level goes $(bold)+1$(), up to $(bold)level 5$().$(br2)Each level of Void Wane: -20% movement speed, -4 damage, -10% non-void damage taken.$(br2)$(italic)Touch the will of the void with your body!$()
